items.title: Windows 11 tests shared Bluetooth audio support, but only for AI PCs
items.description: If you have two headphones, speakers, earbuds, or any other Bluetooth hardware, you can now use both simultaneously on a Copilot+ PC. [...]

items.title: UNC6384 Targets European Diplomatic Entities With Windows Exploit
items.description: The spear-phishing campaign uses fake European Commission and NATO-themed lures to trick diplomatic personnel into clicking malicious links.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28302: ALGO
items.description: A CVSS score 8.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Vera Mensa of Claroty Research - Team82' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-10-31, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-02-28 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
